rendered:
The BA@HGNRs probe was prepared with centrifugation steps, both specified in rpm rather than g-force.

1. First spin: the CTAB-stabilized HGNRs were centrifuged at 6800 rpm, 10 min[1] and then redispersed in an equal volume of KOH solution at high pH.
2. Second spin: after the 4-MPBA[2] incubation (stirred at 300 rpm[3] in the dark), the mixture was centrifuged at 3600[4] rpm for 10 min[5], then resuspended and concentrated in 160 μL[6] of 10 mM NH4HCO3[7] to give the BA@HGNRs probes.

The 300 rpm[8] figure is the stirring speed during incubation, not a centrifugation speed.
